newsitem.title: LATVIA: STOCK VOLUME SINKS, DAUGAVPILS GAINS ON BONUS.
newsitem.headline: STOCK VOLUME SINKS, DAUGAVPILS GAINS ON BONUS.

text.p: * Total volume fell to 46,000 lats on Friday from 53,000 lats.
* Rietumu index was down 0.19 pct to 176.21.
* Most leading shares lost ground amid sluggish trade.
* Daugavpils Chain gained 15 santimes or seven pct to 2.40 lats on volume of 11,400 lats, the bourse's biggest trade. The share was reacting to news it approved a bonus stock issue.
* Official list's RTF fell to 1.24 lats from 1.28 lats on 3,400 lats and Unibanka slipped one santime to 3.49 lats and traded 2,600 lats.
* Staburadze, Lode Brick and Roja Fish cannery were among todays gainers.
Share volumes dropped to 46,000 lats on Friday as the market was stuck in a holiday mood with Daugavpils Chain one of the few gainers on the highest volume on news of its bonus share issue.

The Rietumu Bank share index was down 0.19 percent to 176.21. Daugavpils rose 15 santimes to 2.40 lats on turnover of 11,400 lats after it on Wednesday confirmed that it will carry out a bons share issue of 84 shares for every 100 held.
Volumes in other shares were low, including amid the official list stocks.
Riga Transport Fleet fell to 1.24 from 1.28 lats on 3,400 lats while Unibanka slipped one santime to 3.49 lats on 2,600 lats of trade.
Confectioner Staburadze was the only official list gainer, adding three santimes to 2.65 lats on 5,500 lats of turnover.
The official list will soon get fish cannery Kaija and Riga Shipyard as new members after the bourse board today decided to include them from next week.
Valmiera Glassfibre was also active on the secondary list, turning over 4,800 lats to close unchanged at 1.50 lats.
